# Outdoor Fountain Pros

> > The premier online destination for premium outdoor water fountains and garden water features in a wide variety of styles, from zen and modern designs to tiered and animal-themed fountains.

Outdoor Fountain Pros operates the largest online collection of outdoor water fountains and garden features, partnering with leading brands like Henri Studio and Campania International. The site combines an extensive product catalog with expert resources on fountain maintenance, design, and customer support.

## Featured Collections

- [Top Selling Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/top-selling-fountains): Top-selling fountains from brands like Henri Studio and Campania International
- [Outdoor Wall Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/outdoor-wall-fountains): Wall fountain collection including Andalusia, Long Beach, and modern designs
- [Zen Outdoor Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/zen-outdoor-fountains): Asian-inspired zen fountains including Buddha and bowl designs
- [Modern Outdoor Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/modern-outdoor-fountains): Contemporary water fountains with modern stone and geometric designs
- [Tiered Outdoor Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/tiered-outdoor-fountains): Multi-tier fountains including Savannah, Montreux, and San Pietro styles

## Fountain Types & Styles

- [Garden Outdoor Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/garden-outdoor-fountains): Garden fountains including Platia, Palazzo, and Girona water features
- [Waterfall Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/waterfall-fountains): Waterfall fountains with natural rock and tiered cascade designs
- [Outdoor Bubble Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/outdoor-bubble-fountains): Bubble fountains with soothing water sounds for gardens and patios
- [Bird Bath Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/birdbath-fountains): Birdbath fountains in stone, ceramic, and cast iron styles for gardens
- [Fire Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/fire-fountains): Fire and water fountains combining flame and water features for patios
- [Outdoor Tabletop Fountains](https://www.outdoorfountainpros.com/collections/outdoor-tabletop-fountains): Compact tabletop fountains for patios and small outdoor spaces
